oracle_audit.meaning: Every skipped multiplication had an operand equal to 1 (or was the exact 4*g1 = 2(g1+g1) rewrite) and every full value (g3, g1, g2, disc, residual points, normalised points) equals REF's; every reused v^T v_prev and w^T y equals the direct dot and every w_i^T A w_0 (i >= 1) is 0; the counted differences REF - CAND equal the oracle's skip/reuse counts exactly in every record (34 production-size units incl. all 30 producer cells, 207 small-q records incl. failed attempts).

NRM.arithmetic: Fp::mul(a, b) = a*b mod q, Fp::add reduces; every operand at the skipped sites is already reduced (< q): ga, gb from Fp::add, ha[0] and mb[0] from Fp::mul, u from Fp::mul. So mul(x, 1) = x and add(0, x) = x exactly.

sites.g3: skips mul(ga[0], b[0]) iff b[0] == 1 (operand tested directly)
sites.g2: replaces add(0, mul(ha[0], mb[0])) by ha[0] iff b[0] == 1; mb[0] = local_data mo[0] = mul(b0, b0) = 1 then; also drops the add of the initial 0 (exact)
sites.disc: 4*g1 = (g1+g1)+(g1+g1) mod q: one mul -> two adds, always when NRM=1
sites.normaliser: pv = 1/(first nonzero coordinate); when p[0] != 0 that coordinate is p[0], so p[0]*pv = 1; p[0] == 0 takes the full three-multiplication path (counted, including 0*pv)

NRM.first_coordinate_zero: points with first coordinate 0 never take a skip: a[0]/b[0] == 0 fails the == 1 test, p[0] == 0 fails the != 0 test. Exercised: 56 residual points with p[0] = 0 in the production-size oracle runs, 134 factor-base pairs with b[0] = 0 and 158 such residual points in the small-q sweep, all exact.
NRM.moved_work: none: the only new code are comparisons on values already computed, uncounted exactly as REF's own g3 == 0, disc == 0 and pv[k] != 1 tests; local_data, batch_inv, the fb normalisation (pnorm) and the kind-1 point formula are unchanged (fb.* identical in every unit; kind-1 still multiplies by a[0]).
NRM.count_identity: REF - CAND relations.mul = number of skips (6 sites); REF - CAND relations.add = #g2 skips - 2 #disc. Holds exactly in every oracle run.

LZ.setup: A = R^T D R (matvec_b0 and matvec_pm1 compute the same field values: acc_coef replaces a*v by v or -v only when a = 1 or ell - 1), symmetric. w_0 = y = A b; at iteration i with s_i = w_i^T A w_i != 0: v_i = A w_i, a_i = v_i^T v_i / s_i, b_i = v_i^T v_{i-1} / s_{i-1} (i >= 1), w_{i+1} = v_i - a_i w_i - b_i w_{i-1} (no b term at i = 0). Arithmetic exact in F_ell.
LZ.P: P(i): w_i^T A w_{i-1} = 0. P(1) = v_0^T v_0 - a_0 s_0 = 0; P(i+1) = v_i^T v_i - a_i s_i - b_i w_{i-1}^T A w_i = 0 by P(i) and symmetry. a_i is always a direct dot, so P holds in both modes.
LZ.identity_1: v_i^T v_{i-1} = w_i^T A v_{i-1} = w_i^T A (w_i + a_{i-1} w_{i-1} + b_{i-1} w_{i-2}) = s_i + a_{i-1} P(i) + b_{i-1} Q(i), Q(i) = w_i^T A w_{i-2} = v_{i-1}^T v_{i-2} - a_{i-1} P(i-1) - b_{i-1} s_{i-2} = 0 whenever b_{i-1} was exact; at i = 1 there is no w_{-1} term. By induction from i = 1 identity 1 is exact at every iteration, including when it is itself used (LZ) to form every b.
LZ.identity_2: w_{i+1}^T y = (A w_i)^T w_0 - a_i w_i^T y - b_i w_{i-1}^T y. (A w_0)^T w_0 = s_0 gives the first-iteration form s0 - a_0 wy_0 (wy_0 = y^T y is a direct dot). For i >= 1, w_i^T A w_0 = 0 by full A-orthogonality: for k <= i-2, w_{i+1}^T A w_k = w_i^T A (w_{k+1} + a_k w_k + b_k w_{k-1}) - 0 - 0 = 0 (standard Lanczos induction, exact over a field; scalar Lanczos never narrows, so unlike the block case no column is ever dropped).
LZ.breakdown: s == 0 returns None before wy or vvp of that iteration is used, in both modes; s_prev is a previously checked nonzero s; the w == 0 break and the n + 5 iteration cap see identical iterates. So results, None cases and iteration counts are identical; the no-env path computes both dots exactly as REF (diff and A/A).
LZ.count_identity: per call with I iterations passing the s check, REF - LZ = (I - 1)(2n - 2) - 1 lmul and the same ladd (two n-term dots removed per iteration after the first; 2 lmul + 2 ladd added there and 1 + 1 at the first). Holds exactly for every call in every oracle run and in the stress harness.

negative_controls_note: Each mutant makes one reuse/skip inexact: MUT_LZWY and MUT_LZVV make D and DL1 linear algebra fail (6 attempts instead of 1) and are flagged by the comparator; MUT_NRM produces residual points off the curve and panics in plane_quartic_pic.rs (exit 101, flagged by the exit-code and record checks). So the G1-style comparison has power against an inexact skip or reuse.
